dct_description_sm: 2 bar scales on map, given in “Scala leucarum” and “Milliaria Germanica.”
Decorative cartouches, shield, compass rose, rhumb lines, ships.
From Jansson's Novus atlas, French edition, published in Amsterdam from 1646 to 1656.
This copy has pencil inscription in lower left: 123.
